# Plain `fastapi`, not `fastapi[standard]`: the extra pulls uvicorn, httpx,
# typer and friends, which a Lambda behind API Gateway never runs. Plain
# fastapi is just starlette + pydantic.
# Pinned exactly — Lambda builds should be reproducible, and FastAPI ships
# several releases some weeks.
fastapi==0.141.1
mangum==0.21.0
# Pinned exactly for a second reason beyond reproducibility: tiktoken names
# its cache files after a hash of the encoding's download URL. The vendored
# cache in tiktoken_cache/ was generated by THIS version, so a bump could
# make tiktoken look for a filename that isn't in the zip — and fall back to
# downloading the encoding at cold start, which is what we shipped it to avoid.
tiktoken==0.13.0
